integrity.claim_scope: Exact all-orders homotopy comparison among the hypergraph realization, order complex, Čech complex, and pairwise-intersection Vietoris–Rips complex.
integrity.literature_risk: The closest inspected sources define the relevant general complexes or the projective-plane incidence complex but do not state this comparison. An unindexed specialized note could still overlap.
integrity.reproducibility: The proof is combinatorial; a standard-library verifier reconstructs PG(2,p) for p=2,3,5 and independently checks the incidence counts and predicted cycle ranks.

scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the singleton-plus-line hypergraph of a finite projective plane and does not cover arbitrary subhypergraphs or higher projective dimensions.
The pairwise-intersection Vietoris–Rips complex is the hyperedge complex of Jost–Zhang, not a graph-metric Vietoris–Rips complex.
The bundled computation checks only the Desarguesian prime-order cases q=2,3,5; the general proof is axiomatic.
title: Čech retention and Rips collapse for projective-plane hypergraphs
